data.change_summary: Added invariant validation for `shrimp_params.chloride_protection_factor` in `validate_shrimp_runtime_params()` and extended the malformed-save and `step_hours` preflight regression tables so negative chloride protection factors are rejected through both validation paths. I also ran format and diff checks and attempted the targeted tests, but unrelated pre-existing compile failures outside this patch currently block those test binaries from building.
outstanding_risks: Targeted runtime validation is still pending once the repo compiles again: `cargo test` for the `save_load` and `validation` cases is blocked by unrelated existing errors in `crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs:434` (missing denitrification `ProcessParams` fields) and `crates/tank_core/src/types/state.rs:79` (missing `cumulative_n2_export_mg_n` in `TankState` initialization).

steps.description: Inspected the existing shrimp runtime invariant checks and the two regression tables that cover malformed save loading and `step_hours` preflight validation for shrimp parameter errors.

Added `check_non_negative("shrimp_params.chloride_protection_factor", params.chloride_protection_factor)?;` in `crates/tank_core/src/invariants.rs` and extended both invalid-parameter test tables to include `shrimp_params.chloride_protection_factor = -1.0`.

Ran focused validation commands for formatting, diff hygiene, and the targeted test cases; format and diff checks passed, while the test runs surfaced unrelated pre-existing compile blockers outside the touched files.

validation_evidence: `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load malformed_current_save_with_invalid_molt_mineral_parameters_is_rejected -- --exact` blocked by existing compile error in `crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs:434` (`ProcessParams` initializer missing denitrification fields).

`cargo test -p tank_core --test validation step_hours_rejects_invalid_molt_mineral_parameters_before_simulation -- --exact` blocked by the same existing compile error in `crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs:434`.
`cargo check -p tank_core --lib` blocked by an existing compile error in `crates/tank_core/src/types/state.rs:79` (`TankState` initializer missing `cumulative_n2_export_mg_n`).
